Perceiving Light at Trillion Frames per second. (Femto-photography)
Holy fuck that is amazing! Too bad about the ad.

I had such high hopes for this technology. But unfortunately, this isn't what the title promised it to be.

The "trillion frames per second" is misleading. They just managed to very cleverly synchronize transmitting a light pulse with an extremely high rate frame capture (a very impressive achievement!)

But the video above was created using a different light pulse per frame. That is, you don't see how a single light pulse propagate from left to right, each frame was a different pulse, captured at precisely the right time, then stitched together to make a single video. It does look exactly like what a real trillion frames per second video would look like tho...

Again, this is an awesome achievement, but "trillion frames per second" is a little misleading.
